chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamza, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام), "Can the earth remain without an Imam?" He said: "If the earth were to remain without an Imam, it would sink."

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the Imam, the Divinely appointed authority and guide
key_terms.الْأَرْضُ: the earth, understood here as the inhabited world sustained by Divine order
key_terms.بِغَيْرِ: without, indicating the absence of such authority
key_terms.لَسَاخَتْ: it would sink or collapse, expressing the earth’s inability to endure without an Imam

ai.seo_question: Can the earth remain without an Imam according to Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that the earth cannot remain without an Imam, indicating the necessity of a perpetual Divine Authority among creation. It expresses a foundational teaching about the cosmic and theological role of the Imam in the order and preservation of the world.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can the earth remain without an Imam<sup>asws</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the earth were to remain without an Imam<sup>asws</sup>, it would be bog down (its inhabitants)’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Fudayl from ibn abu Hamza who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘Can the earth be left without the Imam?’” The Imam (a.s.) replied, “ Were to remain without Imam it would obliterate its inhabitants.”
